The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. It holds roughly 8–10 strips of crispy bacon and about 14 sausage pieces.

Bacon: cooked strips weigh about 8 g each. Several of them look broken or overlapping, so I count about 10 strips, or roughly 60 g. At about 540 kcal per 100 g for cooked bacon, that is about 320 kcal. That seems high, so I'll lower it slightly to about 300 kcal.

Sausage: the pieces look like breakfast sausage links cut into chunks. About 14 pieces at roughly 8 g each comes to about 110 g. At about 300 kcal per 100 g, that is about 330 kcal. That feels too high for the visible amount, so I'll assume about 90 g and about 270 kcal.

Total: about 150 g of food and about 550 kcal.
